stem.text: A street lamp is fixed to a wall by a metal rod and a cable.

stem.alt: Diagram of a lamp hung from a point P at the end of a horizontal metal rod fixed to a wall, supported by a cable from the wall; labels wall, cable, metal rod, P and lamp.

stem.text: Which vector triangle could represent the forces acting on the end of the rod at point P?
